sentinels.purpose: Every PEM private-key header in the tests is assembled at runtime from fragments; no committed file carries one, so the repository gate never sees one.
ZERO governed reads, ZERO authenticated provider operations, ZERO real provider values; the provider is the fake world.

positive_controls.description: The runtime catalog carries PRIVATE_KEY_BLOCK and it IS the repository's exported pattern (object identity); both scanners detect every PEM private-key label.
A random opaque, grammar-valid repo-like name is still deferred and adjudicated by the same-run witness; an ordinary repo name is ordinary evidence.
The real dn0ConfigFor binds six events with b25f2d32's delta recert fixed; the five materialized events satisfy CP-1 as configured.

negative_controls.description: Private-key block with and without entropy, Bearer material, userinfo, ghp_ and vcp_ prefixes each STOP at V-R2.S2 with the named detector in the diagnostic, and G-R5 never runs, even when the inventory would match.
An entropy-only value outside the documented grammar STOPs; the witness refuses a grammar-invalid target; the evidence re-scan explains none of these.
The repo gate's annotation allowance does not apply at runtime.
A value tripping entropy and another detector is not adjudicated at all (0 explained).
The b25f2d32 delta recert cannot certify a new candidate.

mutation_controls.description: Private-key detector removed from the runtime catalog; replaced by a narrower copy; shared pattern narrowed back (P01-P03) must be KILLED.
Annotation allowance applied at runtime (P04) must be KILLED.
Grammar layer removed from deferral, witness or re-scan; detector layer removed from the re-scan (P05-P08) must be KILLED.
The old b25f2d32 event accepted for the new candidate; its fixed history event dropped (P09-P10) must be KILLED.
Every earlier production mutant re-killed on this tree; the battery still FAILS on a real survivor.
